title: Phalaris aquatica (botany)

source.dataset: psychonautwiki_db.zip (psychonautwiki.db, SQLite export provided by Hany, file dated 2026-11-25)

plain_text:
Phalaris aquatica (also known as P. tuberosa, Bulbous canary-grass or Harding grass) is a plant in the Phalaris genus. It contains approximately 0.100% DMT, 0.022% 5-MeO-DMT, and 0.005% bufotenin.
